items.title: Brigade Group Hospitality Revenue Rises 41% to INR 161 Crore in Q2
items.snippet: ­The group’s hospitality EBITDA increased 41% year on year to INR 59 crore, with a margin of 37%. Brigade Group reported a 41% year-on-year increase in hospitality EBITDA to INR 59 crore in Q2 FY27, while revenue from the segment stood at INR 161 crore.

items.title: Wyndham Launches Homes & Havens to Take On Marriott
items.snippet: Skift Take: Whether Wyndham's Homes & Havens can compete with Marriott's far larger collection is an open question. But for Wyndham, this is only day one. Wyndham is moving into curated vacation rentals, a market where hotel loyalty programs and credit card issuers are waging an intense competition for travelers.

items.title: Scapia Adds 2 Lakh Villas and Homes to Travel Booking Platform
items.snippet: The launch expands its accommodation offering beyond hotels, with rewards and booking assistance aimed at travellers seeking alternative stays. Scapia has launched Villas & Homes on its travel app, adding more than 2 lakh villas, homestays, apartments and cottages across India and international destinations to its accommodation portfolio.

items.title: Three Weeks to ROI With Canary at Das Aunhamer Suite & Spa
items.snippet: Das Aunhamer Suite & Spa in Bavaria recouped its full Canary Technologies platform cost within three weeks through mobile check-in, AI messaging, and dynamic upsell tools.

items.title: Luxury drives Hyatt’s Q3 RevPAR growth above expectations
items.snippet: The company also saw “exceptionally strong development activity” in the third quarter, as it looks to expand its brand presence across the U.S., said CEO Mark Hoplamazian. Hyatt saw RevPAR increase across all customer segments in Q3, with leisure transient and group RevPAR seeing strong gains, while business transient RevPAR increased in the low single digits, per the report.

items.title: Tarangire Sopa Lodge in Tanzania introduces night game drives
items.snippet: Tarangire Sopa Lodge in Tanzania has introduced night game drives, offering guests an opportunity to explore Tarangire National Park after sunset and observe wildlife activity that is rarely witnessed during daytime safaris. The new experience allows guests to discover the park’s nocturnal wildlife and gain a different perspective on its ecosystem.

items.title: Patna Airport plans customs & immigration facilities by January
items.snippet: Jay Prakash Narayan International Airport in Patna is preparing to introduce customs and immigration facilities, enabling passengers travelling internationally via connecting flights to complete the required formalities at the city airport instead of major hubs such as Delhi and Mumbai. The move is expected to simplify international journeys for passengers departing from Bihar.
